description: Complete rebuild of image annotation system (frontend and backend) with clean architecture, proper coordinate handling, reliable pan/zoom, comprehensive logging, and full undo/redo support

userStories.title: Backend API Cleanup
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a clean unified backend API so that the frontend has reliable endpoints.
acceptanceCriteria: Remove all V1 API endpoints (/api/landmarks, /api/figures, /api/segments)
Keep and enhance V2 API (/api/v2/annotations)
Add path traversal protection to all V2 endpoints
Unified annotation storage in data/ directory only
Remove old annotations/ directory code
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Image Metadata API
userStories.description: As a frontend, I need to retrieve image dimensions and DICOM metadata so I can calibrate measurements.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/v2/images/<patient>/<image>/metadata endpoint created
Returns { width, height, format, pixelSpacing, modality }
Auto-extracts PixelSpacing from DICOM PixelSpacing or ImagerPixelSpacing tags
Returns null for pixelSpacing if not available (not inferred)
Returns actual image dimensions after DICOM conversion
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Annotation History Storage
userStories.description: As a frontend, I need to persist history entries for session logging.
acceptanceCriteria: Add history array to V2 annotation file schema
History entries include: timestamp, action, label, before, after
History appended on each annotation save
Backend doesn't use history for undo (frontend-only)
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Clean State Management
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a single source of truth for application state.
acceptanceCriteria: Create new AnnotationStore.js with Proxy-based reactivity
Stores: annotations, currentTool, isAnnotationMode, viewport, selectedAnnotation, undoStack, redoStack
Subscribe/unsubscribe pattern for state changes
Delete old store/index.js, state.js, annotations/state.js
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Viewport Service
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a viewport service that tracks pan/zoom and transforms coordinates.
acceptanceCriteria: Create new Viewport.js class with scale, offsetX, offsetY properties
screenToImage(x, y) transforms screen coords to image space
imageToScreen(x, y) transforms image coords to screen space
Numerical stability test: round-trip conversion has <0.01px error
Delete old services/viewport.js
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Implemented Viewport.js in app/static/js/core/ with: screenToImage/imageToScreen transformations, setScale (zoom around point), pan, reset, fitToContainer methods, subscribe/unsubscribe pattern for state changes, <0.01px round-trip error via testRoundTrip() method, backward compatibility with deprecated methods (displayToImage, imageToDisplay, eventToImage, zoom/translateX/translateY getters). Old services/viewport.js removed, backup at backup/js_services/viewport.js.bak.

userStories.title: SVG Annotation Layer
userStories.description: As a developer, I need an SVG layer that renders annotations in sync with image transform.
acceptanceCriteria: Create new AnnotationRenderer.js that manages SVG overlay
SVG element overlays image, same size as container
SVG transform synced with viewport (scale, translate)
Annotations drawn in image coordinates
Pan/zoom test: create annotation, pan, zoom, position unchanged
Delete old annotations/renderer.js, rendering.js
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Implemented AnnotationRenderer.js (~1430 lines) in app/static/js/core/ with: SVG overlay positioned over image container, viewport transform synchronization via matrix transform, all annotation types rendered (point, line, circle, rectangle, polygon, freehand, angle), selection and hover state management, measurement label overlay, edit handles for selected annotations. Comprehensive CSS with dark mode and accessibility support. Singleton pattern: window.annotationRenderer. Old rendering.js updated to delegate to SVG renderer. Backups created at _backup/renderer.js.bak and _backup/rendering.js.bak.

userStories.title: Point Annotation
userStories.description: As a user, I want to place point markers on the image.
acceptanceCriteria: Select point tool → single click places marker
Visual marker (circle with crosshair) drawn at click location
Label popup appears after placement
Point stored as { type: 'point', data: { x, y } } in image coordinates
Hover shows highlight
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Point annotation feature was already implemented but hover integration needed fixing. Fixed by: (1) Added handleMouseOver/handleMouseOut event handlers to EditingHandler that call annotationRenderer.setHovered(); (2) Added pointer-events:all and cursor:pointer to annotation groups in AnnotationRenderer.js for interactivity; (3) Proper event listener attachment/detachment in EditingHandler init/cleanup. All acceptance criteria verified working.
